outcome: prevalence of caesarean sections under general anesthesia
cohort: 3613 women who underwent caesarean section at Manipal Teaching Hospital, Pokhara, Nepal from January 2014 to December 2017
finding: The four year medical records showed a fluctuating trend of caesarian sections under general anesthesia, with the rate for emergency caesarean section within the recommended rate while it was slightly higher in elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of general anesthesia for emergency caesarian section was within the recommended rate while it was slightly higher in elective caesarian section.
